# gh-report

> A daily GitHub Action that collects branches, open pull requests, open issues, failed workflows and security alerts for your repositories, then publishes them as a static dashboard on GitHub Pages.

## Project

- [Overview and quickstart](/README.md): Purpose, requirements, quickstart, and usage.
- [Changelog](/CHANGELOG.md): Released changes.
- [Design system](/design-system/README.md): Tokens and components used by the dashboard.
- [Collector script](/gh-repo-report.sh): Reads the GitHub API and writes the report data.

## Policies and support

- [Security](/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
- [Privacy](/PRIVACY.md): Data-handling policy.
- [Support](/SUPPORT.md): Support and troubleshooting information.

## Miscellaneous

- [Agent guide](/AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI coding agents.
